quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road is intersecting ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: A school or school crosswalk is ahead.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Turn on your signal and proceed at normal speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must wait for vehicles on the other road to pass. You don't need to stop completely if no vehicles are coming, but you must slow down and enter carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow posted speed limits.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this yellow sign?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are crossing.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be alert and stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does a five-sided sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to a school zone. Some show crosswalks where children or other pedestrians may cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A 35 mph speed zone starts after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the curve.
Drive 35 mph or slower around the curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive 35 mph or slower around the curve ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. The speed shown is the recommended safe speed for the upcoming curve.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and move to the right lane.
Keep right if you are driving slower than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep right if you are driving slower than other traffic.
questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign shows rules you must follow. This sign means slower drivers should stay in the right lane to let faster traffic pass on the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road work or maintenance is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road work or maintenance is ahead.
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction and maintenance work areas. They help guide drivers safely. Fines for traffic violations may be doubled in these areas.

questions.question: What must you do when you see an eight-sided sign?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, let traffic and pedestrians pass, then proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
Traffic flows both ways on this road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows both ways on this road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of two-way traffic.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: A diamond-shaped yellow sign warns of possible danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of dangers in work areas.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road?

options.text: It turns sharply right, then left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve where the road curves right, then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. The arrow shows the direction that is prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing nearby.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign on the back of a vehicle mean?

options.text: The vehicle is being pulled by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Some vehicles travel slowly, like bicycles, farm vehicles, or horse-drawn carts. This sign warns other drivers that the vehicle will travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates or disability placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction or maintenance work is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Construction or maintenance work is ahead.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of upcoming hazards. Orange warning signs are used for construction areas.

questions.question: What is this cyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles don't have turn signals, so cyclists use hand signals. A left arm straight out means the cyclist is turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height for vehicles in this state.
The maximum width for vehicles on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows how much space is between the road and the bottom of a bridge or overpass (for example, 12 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same way will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.
A road enters from the right.
The road turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road splits and you must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road changes direction or narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road changes direction or narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will change direction or narrow. You may see this sign on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is beginning. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is displayed on slow-moving vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular yellow sign with black lettering means no passing. It appears on the left side of two-way roads where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A side road enters from the left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is ahead. Slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn left or go straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your lane splits into two directions. You may turn left or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crosswalk is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A railroad crossing is ahead. Be ready to stop.
You will always stop at this railroad crossing.
Stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: A railroad crossing is ahead. Be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to stop if the light is flashing.

questions.explanation: A yellow sign with a traffic signal picture warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to respond to it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers to an intersection ahead so they can prepare for traffic or turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down or stop if needed.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection so you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You cannot turn when the light is red.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn when the light is red.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right or left when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: All wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns of conditions where you could lose control. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers to a side road intersecting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes or shift position.

questions.question: What type of situation does this sign warn about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: The right lane is ending. Merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending. Merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that lanes are being reduced and traffic should merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign shows a crosswalk, whether marked on pavement or not. Be alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Turning right is illegal at this intersection.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order for traffic lights?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign shows that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep downhill section is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep downhill section is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downgrade is ahead. Check your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign directs traffic to the right of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street going the wrong way.
You can go if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street going the wrong way.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left turns are not allowed here.
You can turn left only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left turns are not allowed here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means no left turns.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign means you must obey it. This sign says do not pass other vehicles for any reason.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you there is a curve to the right coming up.

questions.question: If you see a flashing red traffic light, you should:

options.text: Be going in the wrong direction.
Treat it like a stop sign.
Not go until the light turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Stop completely. Then yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before going.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully in these conditions.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light means you should:

options.text: Stop and only go when the intersection is clear.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. You do not have to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right ahead.
You must turn right in this lane.
Right turn is allowed only on a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right ahead.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a bright yellow-green background. This sign warns of a sharp turn to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn of hazards. A round sign always warns of a railroad crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you are leaving a divided highway and entering a two-way road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane ends ahead. Drivers in that lane will need to merge.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for traffic coming from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic coming from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns of traffic merging from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you traffic laws. This sign means right turns are not allowed here.

questions.question: When you see a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Look only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that were here before or after you go first.
Look in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop. Then check for traffic in all directions before going.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and be ready to control your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided road and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic from both directions before going.
Let other traffic on the road you want to enter pass first.
Keep your speed steady and check all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic on the road you want to enter pass first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you do not have the right-of-way. Slow down and be ready to stop so other vehicles or pedestrians can pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction the arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you traffic laws. This sign means you must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: People may be crossing the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: People may be crossing the road.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign always means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp left and right turns ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a winding road. Adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you cannot go. It is on one-way streets or when entering the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a crossroad is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to watch for pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down for a curving road ahead.
Slow down and do not brake.
Slow down because the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: If you want to turn left at a red left arrow, you should:

options.text: Turn if you yield to other drivers.
Stop completely and go when safe.
Stop completely and stay stopped while the arrow is red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and stay stopped while the arrow is red.
questions.explanation: A red left arrow means do not turn. Stop before the intersection and stay stopped until the arrow changes.

questions.question: This sign shows a type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of traffic merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Go at normal speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the tracks and wait for a signal before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: When near a railroad crossing, look and listen carefully. Slow down and be ready to stop. Let trains pass before proceeding.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, with or without a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be alert and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only on a green arrow.
You can turn left on green if it is safe.
You must wait for a solid green light to turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn left on green if it is safe.
questions.explanation: Yield means slow down and be ready to stop. You can then proceed if it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering and you should make space for them to merge safely.
Traffic is entering and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering and you should make space for them to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging in. If possible, change lanes to allow merging drivers space to enter safely.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a flagger ahead. Follow their directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow clothing and use paddles and flags to direct traffic.

questions.question: If you see a sign over your lane with an arrow and the word "only", you should:

options.text: Drive in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign controls your lane. You must drive in the direction the arrow shows.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let traffic crossing in front of you pass first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic crossing in front of you pass first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means give the right-of-way. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always mean?
questions.explanation: Farm tractors and other slow vehicles display an orange and red triangle. This warns you to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does an orange-colored sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mark construction areas. Drive carefully and watch for changes.

questions.question: This shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing down is always a yield sign. Slow down and let other traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.question: What is this sign?
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing down is a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What information do blue signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services such as rest areas, food, or hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road has many turns and curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Drive carefully in rain.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns of road work. Stay alert for traffic control devices and workers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You cannot drive in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot drive in this direction.
questions.explanation: A red sign means an action is prohibited. If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way. Turn around right away.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep downgrade or hill is ahead.
The road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep downgrade or hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a dangerous downgrade or hill. It may be steep or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left here. It is unsafe and illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is the only eight-sided sign. You must stop completely. Do not proceed until it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange is used for work zones. This sign warns of a flagger ahead. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may merge ahead.
